note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Monday 5 January, poll Thursday 15 January 1931. Thirteen members were returned unopposed; Dock and Shankill were contested, and the Unionists took Dock from the Socialists (Belfast News-Letter, 6 and 16 January 1931). Returned unopposed.
